summary.short: ANPD resolution approving a regulation applying Brazil's LGPD to small personal-data processing agents (microempresas, small businesses, startups, and similar entities). Allows simplified compliance on records, DPO, security policy and response deadlines, excluding high-risk processing and agents above revenue limits. In force on publication.
summary.long: The resolution approves the regulation applying the LGPD to small processing agents. Its scope covers microempresas, empresas de pequeno porte, startups and similar entities, including individuals and unincorporated entities that act as controllers or operators (Art. 2). Agents are excluded if they carry out high-risk processing or exceed the gross revenue limits of the small-business or startup laws, alone or through an economic group (Art. 3). High-risk processing requires at least one general criterion (large-scale processing or significant effect on rights) and one specific criterion (emerging technologies, surveillance of public areas, solely automated decisions, or sensitive, children's, adolescents' or elderly persons' data) (Art. 4). Eligible agents may keep simplified records (Art. 9), need not appoint a DPO if they provide a contact channel (Art. 11), adopt essential security measures and may adopt a simplified security policy (Arts. 12-13), and receive doubled deadlines for responding to data-subject requests and reporting incidents (Art. 14). Art. 6 states that the relief does not exempt agents from other LGPD provisions. The ANPD may require compliance with waived obligations (Art. 16). The text sets no penalties of its own. It takes effect on publication (Art. 2), and its Art. 14 II was amended by Resolução CD/ANPD nº 15/2024.

entities.name: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)
entities.function: Issues the regulation through its Conselho Diretor; may request proof of small-agent status (Art. 5); provides a simplified records model (Art. 9, par. único); may issue guidance on high-risk assessment (Art. 4, § 3); may require compliance with waived obligations (Art. 16).

evidence.quote: O CONSELHO DIRETOR DA AUTORIDADE NACIONAL DE PROTEÇÃO DE DADOS (ANPD)

notes: The source is a web capture with editorial notes (published 26/04/2024; modified 16/09/2026). The editorial note cites DOU publication of 28/01/2022 and amendment by Resolução 15 of 25 April 2024, while Art. 14, II cites 24 April 2024. Art. 14 contains two items numbered II; the second is the amended wording. Target instruments are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty. Entities are limited to the ANPD; small processing agents are a category, not named entities. Size definitions are delegated to other laws and are not coded here as thresholds.

obligations.summary: Small-scale processing agents must, when asked by the ANPD, prove within fifteen days that they meet the qualification conditions of Arts. 2 and 3.
obligations.applies_from: within fifteen days of the ANPD's request

evidence.quote: Caberá ao agente de tratamento de pequeno porte, quando solicitado pela ANPD, comprovar que se enquadra nas disposições do art. 2º e do art. 3º deste regulamento em até quinze dias.

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents must make information on processing available and respond to data subject requests under Arts. 9 and 18 LGPD, by electronic, printed or other accessible means.

evidence.quote: Os agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte devem disponibilizar informações sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais e atender às requisições dos titulares

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents may organise through representative entities, legal persons or natural persons to negotiate, mediate and conciliate complaints from data subjects.

evidence.quote: Fica facultado aos agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte, inclusive àqueles que realizem tratamento de alto risco, organizarem-se

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents may comply with the duty to keep records of processing operations (LGPD Art. 37) in simplified form.

evidence.quote: podem cumprir a obrigação de elaboração e manutenção de registro das operações de tratamento de dados pessoais

obligations.summary: The ANPD shall provide a model for the simplified processing record.

evidence.quote: A ANPD fornecerá modelo para o registro simplificado de que trata o caput.

obligations.summary: The ANPD shall set out flexibilisation or a simplified procedure for security incident communication for small-scale agents, by specific regulation.

evidence.quote: A ANPD disporá sobre flexibilização ou procedimento simplificado de comunicação de incidente de segurança

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents that do not appoint a data protection officer must provide a communication channel for data subjects.
obligations.conditional_on: where the agent does not appoint an encarregado

evidence.quote: deve disponibilizar um canal de comunicação com o titular de dados

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents must adopt essential and necessary administrative and technical measures based on minimum information security requirements, taking account of privacy risk and their own reality.

evidence.quote: devem adotar medidas administrativas e técnicas essenciais e necessárias, com base em requisitos mínimos de segurança da informação

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents may establish a simplified information security policy, taking into account implementation costs and their structure, scale and volume of operations.

evidence.quote: podem estabelecer política simplificada de segurança da informação

obligations.summary: Small-scale agents may provide the simplified declaration under LGPD Art. 19(I) within fifteen days of the data subject's request.
obligations.applies_from: within fifteen days from the data subject's request

evidence.quote: podem fornecer a declaração simplificada de que trata o art. 19, I, da LGPD no prazo de até quinze dias

obligations.summary: The ANPD may direct a small-scale agent to comply with obligations otherwise waived or relaxed, considering the nature or volume of operations and risks to data subjects.
obligations.conditional_on: considering the relevant circumstances of the situation

evidence.quote: A ANPD poderá determinar ao agente de tratamento de pequeno porte o cumprimento das obrigações dispensadas ou flexibilizadas

enforcement.note: No sanction regime is stated in this text. Art. 16 lets the ANPD require compliance with obligations waived under the regulation, which is not a sanction. LGPD art. 52 is cited only as a basis for considering good practice and simplified security policies (arts. 11 §2, 12 and 13 §2), not as a penalty provision.
